data.exact_reserve_text: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 0.8m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2017. In 2016 there was a reserve release of GBP 1.4m. The Property, Marine and Credit and Political Risk accounts generated a surplus which was partially offset by a strengthening in the Liability and Accident and Health classes.
specific_events: two specific large claims on the Financial Institutions part of our Liability account

named_events.loss_description: exceptional series of large natural catastrophe losses
exceptional series of large natural catastrophe losses

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall gross strengthening of GBP 12.802m on prior year reserves, primarily driven by adverse development in some classes, despite favourable development in others. This gross strengthening contrasts with a reported net release of GBP 0.8m, indicating significant reinsurance recoveries. Key drivers included an exceptional series of large natural catastrophe losses in 2017 (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, and California wildfires), and specific large claims in the Financial Institutions liability account, partly influenced by an FCA review. Conversely, Property, Marine, and Credit & Political Risk accounts generated surpluses.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 0.8m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2017

partially offset by a strengthening in the Liability and Accident and Health classes
2017 was a year marked by an exceptional series of large natural catastrophe losses including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (HIM) in the U.S. and the Caribbean, and wildfires in California
We strengthened reserves for two specific large claims on the Financial Institutions part of our Liability account during 2017 following the market wide FCA review into annuity sales
We had a reserve release on our Credit and Political Risk account following favourable development in the year

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development calculated from the claims development triangle shows a strengthening of GBP 12.802m, which differs from the narrative stating a net release of GBP 0.8m. The gross figure is used as per instructions to prefer gross over net.
